reason: I already have my Toplux and Goli routine and I reorder when it runs out, so I'm not looking for something new to add. The lab report is a good sign, but one more thing in my evening isn't something I need right now.
objection: I'd have to change a routine that already works for me, and I don't know this brand. A lab report on the page is nice, but I can't tell if it's the real thing until I've seen it for myself.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the lab report for a real batch and a few honest reviews from people who finished a box, plus a price near $20 for the first one.
